scope: GF180 C/D nfet_03v3 and pfet_03v3 at W/L=10/0.28 um, 25 C, five process selections. Literal public Idsat/Ioff bounds, independent export equivalence, four-terminal bias/KCL checks and deliberate faults. Threshold is diagnostic. Full device envelopes, layouts, statistical/reliability and installed qualification remain open.

diagnostic.scope: Diagnostic only. Public subcircuit defaults use zero junction areas/perimeters and series resistance. Neither this change nor default solver settings changes the acceptance run.

initial_failures.current_conservation: The 1 fA initial check and 10 fA refinement rejected real low-current solver residuals; tightened solver settings did not remove them. Final application/reference absolute allowance is 100 fA (0.01 pA/um), plus 1 ppm relative. Published bounds are unchanged. Failed pilots and exact native inputs are archived.
initial_failures.windows_unit_sandbox: First 47-test attempt had 20 temporary-file permission errors. Same tests pass as the ordinary user without Windows administrator access. The failing log and record are retained.
initial_failures.audit_version_assumption: Initial independent Windows readback expected Linux ngspice 47; actual Windows engine is 46 with the previously validated runtime hash. Final audit verifies the distinct exact hashes and version headers. No engine was substituted.
initial_failures.fault_metadata: The first complete batch recorded the original case corner in wrong-corner diagnostic metadata. The final runner records the actually selected fault corner. Both complete final batches and their audits were rerun; native outcomes are unchanged.

numerical_policy.threshold_equation: Conventional max-gm tangent minus signed VDS/2; inferred diagnostic, not fully defined by the retained public source.

parent_hosted_snapshot.scope: Six successful workflows, others unfinished; not final hosted acceptance of this change.

remaining: Resolve interpretation/model agreement for literal printed ff current bounds; no upstream cause or rounding policy asserted.
